instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: Several dark spots are scattered across the leaf surface, particularly on the right half. Some are small and isolated. The surrounding surface remains dark green.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: The leaf contains multiple blemishes of different sizes distributed across different areas of the leaf. A few spots are bordered by lighter shades, making them stand out against the green background. The outline of the leaf is clearly visible.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: Dark green color appear across the middle and outer portions of the leaf, with the highest concentration toward the right side. The central vein remains clear and uninterrupted. Most unaffected areas keep a consistent green color.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: Detached leaf on gray background. Several brown-to-dark patches occur on different sections of the leaf, though none dominate the entire surface. The damage is dispersed rather than clustered into a single large area.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: The affected regions vary in both shape and intensity. Some marks appear as narrow streaks, while others form broader patches with darker centers. Green tissue remains visible between nearly all damaged areas. Small yellow halos surround several brown spots.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: Numerous dark spots are scattered across the leaf, especially along the upper and left portions. Some marks remain separate, while others occur close enough together to create denser clusters. The central vein divides the affected areas into two uneven halves.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: The leaf contains a mixture of small circular lesions and larger irregular patches. Several of the darker marks are concentrated near the outer margins, while others extend toward the middle. Green tissue remains visible throughout the surface. Several lesions have dark centers with brown margins.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: Compared with the other leaves in this group, this one contains a greater number of distinct darkened areas. The spots vary noticeably in size and shape, creating a more crowded appearance. No single patch dominates the entire leaf.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: Multiple brown-to-black lesions distributed across much of the leaf. The highest concentration appears toward the upper left section, though spots are present elsewhere as well. The leaf retains its overall structure despite the damage.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: The surface is broken up by many scattered dark regions that contrast strongly with the surrounding green tissue. Some lesions have well-defined edges, while others blend gradually into nearby areas. The pattern extends across several sections of the leaf rather than remaining confined to one location.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: The leaf displays a network of pale yellow-green areas separated by darker veins. Much of the discoloration follows the natural structure of the leaf, creating a patterned appearance across the surface. The margins remain mostly intact.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: Several sections between the veins appear lighter than the surrounding tissue. The result is a mosaic-like arrangement of green and yellow-green regions that extends across much of the leaf. No major tearing or edge damage is visible.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: The central and upper portions contain the highest concentration of faded tissue. Veins remain darker and more defined, standing out against the lighter areas around them. Diffuse chlorosis extends toward the leaf tip. The leaf maintains its overall shape.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: Detached leaf photographed on a darker background. The most obvious feature is the contrast between the pale interveinal regions and the darker vein network. Color variation is visible across most of the surface. Interveinal chlorosis covers most of the visible leaf area.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: Rather than forming distinct spots, the discoloration appears in connected patches spread between veins. The darker green lines of the leaf structure remain prominent throughout. The pattern covers a large portion of the visible leaf area. Chlorotic patches are connected along the interveinal regions.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: The leaf has a patchwork of dark green and yellow-green areas spread across nearly the entire surface. The lighter sections are concentrated between the veins, giving the leaf an uneven appearance. The edges remain mostly intact.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: Several pale regions stand out against the darker green background. The color variation follows a repeating pattern across the leaf, making the surface look textured even from a distance. Green veins are surrounded by chlorotic tissue.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: Most of the leaf is affected by uneven coloring rather than isolated spots. Bright and dark green sections sit next to each other across multiple parts of the leaf. The center vein remains clearly visible. Diffuse interveinal chlorosis extends throughout the leaf.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: Strong color variation across the entire leaf. The lighter areas form a network-like pattern while darker green remains along several veins and margins. The shape of the leaf is unchanged.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: Instead of one damaged area, the color difference appears throughout the leaf. The alternating shades of green create a mottled look that covers most of the visible surface.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: The leaf is dark green overall, with a few scattered discolored patches visible along the surface. Most of the visible change occurs near the center and upper portions of the leaf. Large sections remain unaffected.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: Several small brown marks interrupt the green surface but remain separated from one another. The central vein creates a clear dividing line through the middle. The edges show little visible damage.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: The leaf contains only a moderate amount of discoloration. A few spots stand out against the darker green background, while the majority of the surface remains consistent in color. The leaf shape remains unchanged. Brown necrotic lesions are confined to a few localized areas.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: Detached leaf with scattered dark patches. The marks vary slightly in size, though none cover a large portion of the surface. Green tissue dominates most of the visible area. Several lesions are visible near the central and upper lamina.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: A handful of blemishes appear across the leaf without forming large clusters. The darker spots contrast with the surrounding green tissue, making them noticeable despite their limited size. The overall appearance remains fairly uniform.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: This leaf has an irregular shape with several lobes and noticeable color variation. Bright yellow-green bands run along parts of the leaf, while darker green remains in the center. A brown patch is visible near one of the upper edges. Marginal chlorosis is visible along the leaf

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: The surface contains alternating bands of light and dark green that follow the shape of the leaf. Some sections appear slightly curled or folded. The upper portion shows a small area of browning.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: The color pattern is spread across the entire leaf rather than staying in one location. Lighter regions trace the outer sections, while darker green remains around the center vein. The leaf outline appears uneven.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: The leaf combines bright yellow-green margins with darker green central tissue. Uneven folding across the surface creates shadows and texture differences. The color variation is visible from the base to the uppermost lobe.

instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: Multi-lobed leaf with strong contrast between pale and dark green areas. Several sections appear bent, giving the leaf a twisted appearance. A small brown patch occurs near the tip.
